channel.title: Government – HxGN Spotlight
channel.description: Hexagon’s platform for original stories from opinion leaders and customers

item.title: Smart digital realities create smarter cities
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode, we sat down with technology thought leaders and discussed how city leaders and officials can use Hexagon’s digital twin and AI capabilities to create better policies that affect housing, urban planning, mobility, climate change and more.

item.title: Location Intelligence: Streamlining transportation efforts in Zürich
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode of Location Intelligence we talk to VBZ, the public transport operator in Zürich, about how it uses Hexagon's geospatial solutions to optimise their transportation efforts.

item.title: Smart monitoring is a critical step in cutting down on deforestation
item.dc:creator: Brian Tidwell
item.description: Hexagon is dedicated to providing GIS and remote sensing tools that allow students and researchers to make a difference in the fight against deforestation.

item.title: For women in leadership, all roads lead to technology
item.dc:creator: Brian Tidwell
item.description: With the recent celebration of International Women’s Day, businesses from across the spectrum of industries are highlighting the exceptional work and priceless contributions of the women who help their companies to grow and thrive.

item.title: Hexagon laser scanners are a “game changer” for forensic investigators
item.dc:creator: Edward Morgan
item.description: Featured in the BBC Documentary “Forensics, the Real CSI,” laser scanners by Leica Geosystems (a part of Hexagon) are used by investigators to capture an accurate 3D image of a location in Dudley, West Midlands, England

item.title: Lessons learned from the world of sports
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode of HxGN Radio, we discuss what city leaders can learn from the shifting landscape of sports leagues. We also talk about how money, short-term thinking and politics can doom even the most well-intentioned initiatives.

item.title: Redefining security and surveillance through sensor fusion
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: An innovative combination of 3D surveillance sensors is accelerating the path to autonomous and making our shared spaces safer.

item.title: Location Intelligence: Building your professional network in the geospatial field
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: Networking is a vital component of your professional life from helping you discover job opportunities to finding a mentor. In the latest edition of Location Intelligence, we talk about professional networking opportunities in the geospatial industry, including professional associations, conferences, events, LinkedIn, and more.

item.title: Location Intelligence: Ensuring everybody counts with a smarter census
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In the latest episode of Location Intelligence, we discuss effective strategies and location intelligence solutions that can help national statistical offices overcome a myriad of census challenges.

item.title: COVID-19 maps help manage the ongoing crisis
item.dc:creator: hexagon
item.description: Location intelligence is about more than maps. In addition to tracking new coronavirus cases, authorities are also providing more granular data to help us navigate the pandemic.
